records.official_name: In Dangan Channel (担杆水道分道通航制)

records.reporting_relationship_basis: Pearl River Estuary VTS has 21 reporting lines (S15) but no source places a reporting line or separate SRS on the Dangan TSS.
records.complexity_reason: VTS coverage recently extended; adjoins Hong Kong VTS (East Lamma) at the second precautionary area.
records.open_questions: COLREG.2/Circ.71 (ics.org.ir copy) failed to load; Guangdong MSA page (S15) does not name Dangan; exact VTS area limits not retrieved; whether Shenzhen VTS has any role not established.

records.tss_identity_note: 33 CFR 167.1700-167.1703: four parts (Prince William Sound TSS, Valdez Arm TSS, Cape Hinchinbrook and Bligh Reef precautionary areas) (S23). IMO adoption circular not retrieved.
records.vts_relationship_basis: VTS area is north of the Cape Hinchinbrook Light to Schooner Rock Light line, 146°30'W to 147°20'W (S22); the TSS lanes (60°20.6'N to 60°58.9'N, about 146°46'W to 147°04'W) lie within it, and the Valdez Arm VTS Special Area is defined by the Valdez Arm TSS (S22). The VMRS monitoring area extends south to 60°00'N (S24). The Cape Hinchinbrook precautionary area extends to 59°51.8'N and 146°00'W, partly outside both.
records.reporting_relationship_basis: No separate mandatory SRS; VTS reporting points (Cape Hinchinbrook, Naked Island, Bligh Reef, Rocky Point, Entrance Island) are VTS duties under 33 CFR 161 (S22).
records.applicability_notes: VTS Special Area rules apply to vessels of 1600 GT or more and towing vessels 8 m or more (33 CFR 161.60(d)) (S22).
records.complexity_reason: VTS covers lanes fully, precautionary area partly; special area rules.
records.open_questions: Southern part of Cape Hinchinbrook precautionary area lies outside the VTS and VMRS areas.

records.source_label: In the Strait of Juan de Fuca and its Approaches
records.official_name: In the Strait of Juan de Fuca and its approaches
records.tss_identity_note: Grouped label. 33 CFR 167.1300-167.1303 (approaches: western approach, southwestern approach, precautionary area 'JF') and 167.1310-167.1315 (Strait: western, southern, northern, eastern lanes and precautionary area 'PA') (S26). IMO adoption circular not retrieved.
grouped_components: Approaches to the Strait of Juan de Fuca (western approach, southwestern approach, precautionary area JF)
Strait of Juan de Fuca (western, southern, northern, eastern lanes, precautionary area PA)
records.vts_relationship_basis: CVTS for the Juan de Fuca Region: VTS Puget Sound and Canadian centres manage traffic irrespective of the boundary (S25). Seattle Traffic Ch 5A covers US waters east of 124°40'W; Prince Rupert Traffic Ch 74 covers waters west of 124°40'W within 12 nm of Vancouver Island, north of 48°N and east of 125°15'W, which contains the approaches TSS (about 125°00'W to 125°09'W) (S24). Canada's Victoria VTS Zone follows the boundary through Juan de Fuca Strait to 124°40'W; Prince Rupert VTS Zone lies west of 124°40'W to the territorial sea boundary (S27).
records.reporting_relationship_basis: No IMO SRS found. Canadian sailing plan and position reports (SOR/2025-275) and US VMRS reporting are VTS duties recorded under the services.
records.applicability_notes: Canadian VTS Zone rules apply to vessels of 300 GT or more, towing/pushing with combined 500 GT or more, and vessels carrying pollutants or dangerous goods (S27).
records.complexity_reason: Cross-border cooperative VTS with two national services and separate US and Canadian rule sets.
records.open_questions: Whether the southern parts of the approaches TSS (south of the international boundary, outside US territorial sea) fall in any VTS area not fully plotted; NAVCEN page not re-fetched.

method_notes: Access date 2026-09-29. MSC.73(69) sector limits exist only as chartlets; MPA 'Vessels Arriving in Singapore' page gives sector longitudes and is the key source for segment allocation, with Singapore Port Information (file.go.gov.sg) giving TSS coordinates. PDFs were text-extracted locally with pdfminer. Unreachable: hydro.gov.au (timeouts/503), mintrans.gov.ru (connection reset), ics.org.ir (COLREG.2/Circ.71), Admiralty MSI NM 17 (HTTP 500), garant.ru (blocked); consultant.ru body paywalled. Useful: eCFR API renderer for 33 CFR; Justice Laws for SOR/2025-275 (the older SOR/89-98 is repealed); rg.ru for official texts of Russian port rules; Hubla DGST news pages for Indonesian reporting. Suggest obtaining IMO Ships' Routeing (current edition) for adoption dates of Russian, Hong Kong, Australian and US schemes.
